spreadingFlames.intro:
A wave of fires and strange "accidents" has Arkham on edge, and hooded figures have been seen near every one of them.

Your friend is sure they are to blame and asked you to meet at their dorm room at Miskatonic University. When you arrive, the room is empty and the building far too quiet…
spreadingFlames.noResolution:
You come to at the edge of campus, eyes stinging from the smoke, as the university burns building after building.

In the chaos you find Dr. Henry Armitage, stunned before the ruins of the library. Too many questions remain: who was chasing you, and what did the hooded figures want?
spreadingFlames.resolution1:
Dozens of students band together to fight the blaze. Dr. Armitage puts a hand on your shoulder: if you want to find your friend and whoever took them, you must leave now, and he will explain everything on the way.

You could stay and help, but it would cost you precious time.
spreadingFlames.armitageBearer: Choose which investigator becomes the bearer of Dr. Henry Armitage. This story asset is added to their deck ignoring deckbuilding rules and does not count toward deck size.
spreadingFlames.go: "There's no time. We have to go." (Resolution 3)
spreadingFlames.resolution2: Working side by side with the others, you hold back the flames until the Arkham Fire Department arrives. With things under control, you hurry to meet Dr. Armitage.
spreadingFlames.resolution3: You flee the campus with Dr. Armitage and leave the university to its fate, sirens wailing behind you on the way to his apartment.
spreadingFlames.setup:
Gather the scenario's encounter sets.

Put Your Friend's Room into play and set the other campus locations aside. Each investigator begins at Your Friend's Room.

Set aside, out of play, the 5 copies of Fire!, the Dr. Henry Armitage story asset and the Servant of Flame enemy.

Shuffle the remaining encounter cards to build the encounter deck.

smokeAndMirrors.intro:
You follow Dr. Armitage to his apartment while black smoke hides the moon. He tells you several students vanished after attending "exclusive" meetings of a group calling itself the Brethren of Ash, and that your friend left him a list of attendees before disappearing.

You decide to question the suspects and meet at Velma's Diner in Easttown before midnight. Armitage advises a light touch over brute force, but you may have no choice.
smokeAndMirrors.codex1: After a chase you find the haughty eschatologist hiding in a bookshop. He went to the meeting out of academic curiosity: the Brethren of Ash worship an ancient fire deity called Elokoss and obey a queen.
smokeAndMirrors.codex2: The garage foreman finally invites you to sit. She went because coworkers talked about a "glorious rebirth" for followers; those three coworkers have not shown up for weeks.
smokeAndMirrors.codex3: The crime boss laughs at the mention of the cult. Two of her men caught a pair of them snooping around one of her joints and something was very wrong with them, but she will not tell you where.
smokeAndMirrors.codex4: The officer relents: the cultists insisted the missing went willingly, took him to a meeting near the docks and paid him to keep quiet. They all had strange, hypnotized eyes.
smokeAndMirrors.codex5: The librarian is searching for her missing roommate and found a book of sacrifices and impossible symbols written in Akkadian. Translating it would take weeks.
smokeAndMirrors.codex6: After her show, the singer tells you two men in hideous robes accosted her a week ago, a hand with an eye on their hoods. Her bodyguard scared them off.
smokeAndMirrors.codexServant: Your nemesis lies unconscious at your feet; the flames around them have died and the mask will not come off. Perhaps it would be better to finish them here and now… The investigators must decide.
smokeAndMirrors.finishThem: They are too dangerous to leave alive (victory display; each investigator draws 3 cards).
smokeAndMirrors.holdThem: Hold them for questioning later (beneath the act; each investigator gains 1 clue).
smokeAndMirrors.noResolution: On the way to Velma's Diner you go over what you learned: plenty of leads, few results. You can only hope Dr. Armitage fared better.
smokeAndMirrors.resolution1: In the cab to Easttown it becomes clear: despite their efforts to hide, you have found the real culprit. You hope it is enough to save your friend.
smokeAndMirrors.resolution2: You stop by the hideout where you left your unconscious nemesis. It smells of smoke and the handcuffs are smashed, not melted: someone helped them escape.
smokeAndMirrors.setup:
Choose one of the two Downtown versions and one of the two Uptown versions at random; remove the others. Put Northside, Easttown, Merchant District, Waterfront District, Southside and French Hill into play.

Miskatonic University enters on its In Flames side if the university burned, or Quiet Campus if the investigators saved it (then place 1 doom on the agenda). Each investigator begins there.

Set one suspect (People of Arkham) aside at random without looking; shuffle the rest with the Servant of Flame and deal them facedown beneath Northside, Downtown, Southside, French Hill, Uptown and Waterfront District.

Place 1 doom on the agenda per investigator. The bearer of Dr. Henry Armitage puts him into play (he takes no ally slot). Set the Mark of Elokoss copies aside and shuffle the rest as the encounter deck.
smokeAndMirrors.codex1Attempt: The haughty Mr. Renfield tries to send you off politely, but at the words "Brethren of Ash" he bolts down the street, faster than he looks.
smokeAndMirrors.codex2Attempt: Cornelia Akely, on the night shift at a run-down garage, greets you with a cigarette; the moment you mention the cult, her face hardens and she points to the door.
smokeAndMirrors.codex3Attempt: The O'Bannion boss has no interest in your questions, though she will happily get rid of any trouble for you… for a price. More palms will need greasing.
smokeAndMirrors.codex4Attempt: At the mention of the cult, the officer pulls his nightstick and suggests you poke your nose elsewhere. You brace for a fight.
smokeAndMirrors.codex5Attempt: The librarian waves your questions away while pulling more books off the shelf. Perhaps the only way to get her attention is to help her find what she is looking for.
smokeAndMirrors.codex6Attempt: Margaret Liu, one of the best-known singers in town, is lost in her performance. You will have to get creative to catch her attention.

queenOfAsh.intro1:
At Velma's Diner, over two slices of apple pie, Dr. Armitage explains what he has learned: the Brethren of Ash are not conspirators but thralls of an ancient goddess they call Elokoss. A mark on the skin singles out her own, who do not even know they are under her sway.

Your pursuer, the Servant of Flame, heralds her return and gathers sacrifices for a rebirth that, according to prophecy, will happen tonight.
queenOfAsh.intro2: You search the Servant of Flame's home: an invitation to a secret meeting, muddy boots, bootlegging records from the Waterfront and a photo of three candlelit faces. Everything points to the Arkham sewers. You go down to find your friend.
queenOfAsh.intro3: After hours poring over your few clues, Armitage concludes that the ritual is taking place in the Arkham sewers. It is your only lead, and time is short: the agenda starts with 1 doom.

codex.DavidRenfield: Unmasked, David Renfield refuses your help: he welcomed her willingly. He dies laughing weakly. Each investigator may search their deck for a Tome or Spell card and play it, ignoring its cost.
codex.CorneliaAkely: Cornelia Akely stares at her bloody hands, dazed: she thought it was all a nightmare. Seeing your wounds, she offers to help. Each investigator heals 3 damage.
codex.NaomiOBannion: Naomi O'Bannion wakes up furious and demands to know what kind of party this is. As you help her up, she pays you well for the rescue. Each investigator gains 5 resources.
codex.SgtEarlMonroe: Sergeant Monroe, terrified, remembers nothing and stares at his blood-spattered clothes. Each investigator may search their deck for a Weapon asset and play it, ignoring its cost.
codex.AbigailForeman: Abigail Foreman squeezes your hands: Elokoss must not awaken. Before passing out she hands you a crumpled note. Each investigator draws 3 cards.
codex.MargaretLiu: Margaret Liu gets up remarkably calm amid the chaos and you point her to the exit. Each investigator heals 3 horror.

queenOfAsh.noResolution: Dr. Armitage barely escapes the sewers. By dawn an unquenchable fire rages through Easttown for three days; those who fled speak of ghastly faces in the flames. Of his companions, and of the Brethren of Ash, no trace remains.
queenOfAsh.resolution1: Against all odds, the vessel of Elokoss has been destroyed. Among the waking cultists you find your friend, frightened but unharmed. Leading them out, you notice a faint mark on their neck, still visible: it may wake again someday.
queenOfAsh.resolution2: Dr. Armitage chants inhuman words from a tome taken from a cultist and the burning tree crumbles to ash. The cultists are freed from her sway, your friend among them, without a trace of the mark. Even so, for months the faintest smell of smoke will set your pulse racing.
queenOfAsh.resolution3: The old sluice gate screeches open and a torrent floods the tunnels. You do not try to run: you did what had to be done. As the water rises, you think of your friend, of Armitage and of all who drowned to stop an ancient evil.
queenOfAsh.setup:
Put Underground Cistern into play. Shuffle the sewer locations and put them into play unrevealed, without knowing which is which; set Sluice Control aside. Each investigator begins at Sewer Culvert.

Check the campaign log: if the investigators scoured Arkham for answers, each begins with 1 clue; if they stirred up trouble, 1 cultist per investigator enters play, each at a different tunnel; if they killed the Servant of Flame, remove it from the game (otherwise set it aside).

With 3 or 4 players, place 1 doom on the agenda. Set aside the Fire! copies, the Collector reward and the Elokoss, Queen's Knight and Herald of Flame enemies. The rest forms the encounter deck.

brethrenOfAsh.prologue:
Arkham has never been an ordinary city: every week the paper reports another gruesome crime or disappearance, and even the most skeptical cannot deny that something is wrong.

Still, people prefer to look away. Six months after the great flood the city rebuilds and boasts of progress, but among the ashes of the recent fires some whisper that someone, or something, wishes to be reborn.

midwinterGala.intro1: On a freezing winter night, the mysterious Lantern Club has invited you to a party at its old Kingsport manor. You are handed a bone-white mask and join New England’s elite among dreamlike paintings and unsettling sculptures.
midwinterGala.intro2: Declan Pearce, the club’s nomarch, presents the night’s attraction: the Jewel of Sarnath, a gem said to grant wishes. Among the guests you notice the gaze of a tall, silent masked figure. Your invitation came with a note promising a reward for helping obtain the Jewel; at last you find your contact.
midwinterGala.contact: Choose which faction asked for your help: it is your allied faction and sets your objective. Another faction, chosen at random, becomes your rival.

contactChoice.foundation: A stern agent in a tailored suit: the Foundation
contactChoice.syndicate: A businessman with a cigar: the Syndicate
contactChoice.lodge: Carl Sanford: the Silver Twilight Lodge
contactChoice.kingsport: A bearded captain in a worn coat: the Locals of Kingsport

faction.foundation: Agent Valeriya Antonova investigates disappearances on behalf of “the authorities” and suspects the Lantern Club and Declan Pearce. She believes the Jewel may be the source of very strange phenomena.
faction.miskatonic: Dean Caldwell Philips wants to study the ancient gem, which vanished from a Tibetan monastery in the 12th century. If only there were a way to examine it more closely…
faction.syndicate: Johnny Valone offers you a deal: nobody will suspect you, so you are perfect to get the Jewel. The reward will be generous.
faction.lodge: Carl Sanford wants the Jewel for the Lodge’s collection and suspects there is more going on here. In return he promises knowledge and wealth.
faction.kingsport: Captain William Bain points at the silent figure in the corner: they call him “the Bloodless Man”, and he must be behind whatever the club is planning. The Jewel can bring nothing good in their hands.

midwinterGala.setup: Each investigator begins at the Lobby. Your faction’s Leader enters play under your control; its guests and others from the guest deck wait in the ground-floor rooms. The Bloodless Man waits, exhausted, in the Lantern Chamber with The Pale Lantern. The monsters, Declan Pearce and the Jewel of Sarnath are set aside.

interlude.foundation: Declan Pearce appears, exhausted, in the Lantern Chamber. The Jewel is attached to the Bloodless Man (or to the Lantern Chamber if he is not in play).
interlude.miskatonic: Declan Pearce appears at the rightmost second-floor room with the Jewel attached. He cannot be damaged or leave play while he holds it.
interlude.syndicate: The Jewel, Declan Pearce and the top encounter card are shuffled and hidden beneath the second-floor rooms as “mysteries”.
interlude.lodge: The Jewel and Declan Pearce are shuffled with 7 encounter cards and placed on the bottom of the encounter deck.
interlude.kingsport: Declan Pearce appears ready in the Lantern Chamber with the Jewel attached, bearing damage and doom. A new guest arrives at the Lobby.

midwinterGala.mayhem: The Bloodless Man strides toward you, staggers and falls. His suit tears open and tentacles and fangs burst out: he is now an abomination.
midwinterGala.calm: The clamor quiets for a moment. Each investigator may heal 1 horror from an investigator or guest at their location.
midwinterGala.goodbye: The party turns into a massacre. Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
midwinterGala.noResolution: You wake up frozen in the snow outside the empty manor. You don’t remember how you escaped, but you will never forget this gala.
midwinterGala.resolution1: You see your contact’s silhouette against the moon in front of the manor. You got the Jewel of Sarnath.
midwinterGala.resolution2: Agent Antonova will report to her superiors; for now she leaves you the Jewel, but she will be back for it. You wonder whether you are her guinea pig.
midwinterGala.resolution3: The dean is delighted with the gem but would rather not keep it on campus. He asks you to bring it to his office next week.
midwinterGala.resolution4: After tonight, Valone won’t take the Jewel anywhere near Arkham: he leaves it to you as a keepsake, with a wad of cash for saving his skin.
midwinterGala.resolution5: Sanford shouts at his underlings; you pocket the Jewel and slip away. You think it is safer with you than with the Lodge.
midwinterGala.resolution6: Captain Bain puts the Jewel in your hand: he says it can do good in hands like yours. When you look up, he is gone.
midwinterGala.resolution7: From the cab you see the Bloodless Man’s face staring at you from a window. Kingsport, city of fog and legend: now you understand why.

excelsior.intro1: For weeks there have been strange rumours about Arkham’s Excelsior Hotel: disappearances, odd sightings and sudden closures. Sergeant Monroe will not listen to you. Then a man in a trench coat bumps into you downtown, and later you find a note in your pocket: “I have answers. Room 225. Tonight. Come alone. They’re watching!”
excelsior.intro2: The hotel is busy and everything looks normal, yet the warning will not leave your mind. You hurry up the stairs alone, wondering whether coming without telling anyone was wise, and knock on the blood-red door of room 225.
excelsior.intro3: The hotel is busy and everything looks normal, yet the warning will not leave your mind. At least you told people you trust where you were going. You stand before the blood-red door of room 225, take a deep breath and knock.
excelsior.intro4: In the suite, the man who gave you the note paces nervously, rambling about secret meetings and watchful staff, while a curved dagger rests on the table. He pours two drinks and hands you one. His voice fades as if from the end of a tunnel, your sight blurs… and the next thing you know, you are standing, your glass falling to the floor.
excelsior.setup: The lead investigator starts in Room 225 with the Bloodstained Dagger; the others start in the Foyer. The five Lead assets form the Leads deck. The other locations, the Arkham Officers, Sergeant Monroe and the What Have You Done? weakness are set aside.
excelsior.murderBack: The police arrive: Sergeant Monroe waits in the Foyer and Arkham Officers start patrolling the hotel. The lead investigator draws What Have You Done?. For each thing you did not cover up in Room 225 (the blood, the body, the room), 1 clue appears in Room 225 and 1 doom on an Arkham Officer.
excelsior.specialInvestigationBack: You failed to solve the crime and clear your names! (→R3)
excelsior.whatHappenedBack: The rest of the hotel comes into play and the remaining Leads are removed. For each Lead asset in play, 3 related encounter cards are shuffled into the encounter deck along with the discard pile.
excelsior.truth1: Sergeant Monroe stops your investigation, hand near his gun: everything points at you, so you had better tell him everything now. Will you tell him the truth or lie about your involvement?
excelsior.truth2: You tell him everything: the rumours, the note, the murder. It sounds crazy, but it is true. He will only believe you if you hid nothing, have at least 2 clues per investigator on each Lead and there are no Innocent enemies in the victory display.
excelsior.truth3: You lie through your teeth. He will only believe you if you cleaned up the blood, hid the body and tidied up the room, and there are no Innocent enemies in the victory display.
excelsior.truth4: Monroe does not believe a word and draws his weapon, but a crash shakes the hotel and he runs off, promising to cuff you next time. Sergeant Monroe and every Arkham Officer are removed from the game.
excelsior.truth5Title: The Police Are on Your Side
excelsior.truth5: Little by little the evidence convinces him: you were drugged and someone else is pulling the strings. An investigator takes control of Sergeant Monroe and every Arkham Officer is removed from the game.
excelsior.truth6Title: The Police Are on Your Side
excelsior.truth6: Monroe nods, convinced you had nothing to do with it, and offers to help you find the real culprit. An investigator takes control of Sergeant Monroe and every Arkham Officer is removed from the game.
excelsior.truth7: You now understand much more: you are not the real culprit. Doom is removed from play and, depending on the two Lead assets, The True Culprit becomes both the current act and the current agenda.
excelsior.noResolution: You collapse, losing consciousness among the screams of other victims. The plans set in motion at the Excelsior can no longer be stopped. Proceed to Resolution 2.
excelsior.noResolutionResigned: You fled the hotel without solving the mystery, which did little to prove your innocence. Soon the police knock on your door. Proceed to Resolution 3.
excelsior.resolution1: Days later the Excelsior reopens as if nothing had happened. Nightmares still haunt you, and when someone starts asking about the hotel you write a note: “It’s all a facade. Room 225. Tonight. It’s not over.” The lead investigator adds What Have You Done? to their deck and may add the Bloodstained Dagger. If the police are on your side, one investigator may add Sergeant Monroe.
excelsior.resolution2: You wake in the Excelsior restaurant with a glass of water in your hand, as if it had all been a dream. Weeks later a stranger slips another note into your pocket: “It’s all a facade. Room 225. Tonight. It’s not over.” If it is the first time you play this scenario, you may play it again from Setup.
excelsior.resolution3: You wait in a cell, sure the evidence will keep you behind bars. An officer slips you a note —“It’s all a facade. Room 225. Tonight. It’s not over.”— and your cell door swings open. If it is the first time you play this scenario, you may play it again from Setup.

doomed.title: Doomed
doomed.body: When a doomed enemy is defeated (by an investigator or an effect), place 1 doom on the agenda, which can make it advance. Discarding it does not count as defeating it.

hunter.title: Hunter
hunter.body: At the start of the enemy phase, each ready, unengaged hunter moves one location along the shortest path toward the nearest investigator. It does not move if an investigator is already at its location. On a tie, its prey decides, otherwise the lead.

peril.title: Peril
peril.body: While you resolve a card with peril, you cannot confer with the group and nobody else can play cards, trigger abilities or commit cards to your tests.

prey.title: Prey
prey.body: Some enemies pursue a specific investigator: among several at the same distance (or at its location), they choose the one who best fits their prey.

retaliate.title: Retaliate
retaliate.body: If you fail a test while attacking a ready enemy with retaliate, it attacks you after results are applied (engaged with you or not). It does not exhaust for this.

surge.title: Surge
surge.body: After you draw and resolve an encounter card with surge, draw and resolve another one.

codex.title: The codex
codex.body: Some cards refer to a numbered codex entry. When triggered, its text is read and its instructions resolved; the table shows it in a window.

alert.title: Alert
alert.body: If you fail a test while evading an enemy with alert, it attacks you after results are applied. It does not exhaust for this.

aloof.title: Aloof
aloof.body: An aloof enemy does not automatically engage investigators at its location; you must engage it with an action (or an effect).

elusive.title: Elusive
elusive.body: After an elusive enemy is attacked (and not defeated) or evaded, it moves away to a connecting location, without investigators if possible, and disengages.

massive.title: Massive
massive.body: A ready massive enemy counts as engaged with each investigator at its location, attacks all of them in the enemy phase and only exhausts after all its attacks. It cannot be placed in a threat area.

patrol.title: Patrol
patrol.body: In the enemy phase (step 3.2), each ready, unengaged patrol enemy moves one location along the shortest path toward its destination (The Bloodless Man: the nearest location with a guest). With several destinations, the lead decides.

guests.title: Guests
guests.body: Guests are story assets waiting at locations. Parley with them (a test of one of their icons, difficulty 3) to take control; they take no ally slot. Only their controller can use their abilities.

spellbound.title: Spellbound
spellbound.body: A spellbound guest is placed facedown at its location, with no controller and no damage or horror. A Leader that would become spellbound is removed from the game instead. Flipping it faceup readies it and ends the spell.

score.title: Score
score.body: At the end of the game you score tasks: manor locations with no clues, guests controlled, no spellbound cards, ending on agenda 1 or 2, key enemies in the victory display, little damage or horror, difficulty and your faction points. Every 10 points give 1 experience (5 at most).

excelsiorPatrol.title: Patrol
excelsiorPatrol.body: In the enemy phase (step 3.2), each ready, unengaged patrol enemy moves one location along the shortest path toward its designated location (Arkham Officer: nearest location with clues; Hotel Guest: nearest Crime Scene; Vengeful Specter: Room 245). With several options, the lead decides; it does not move into a location blocked by a card ability.

parley.title: Parley
parley.body: Some enemies have a parley action ability. Parleying does not provoke attacks of opportunity. What Have You Done? adds a cost: discard a random card from your hand.

leads.title: Leads
leads.body: The five Lead assets form the Leads deck. Spend clues to draw them; once you control two, the act advances. Some locations let you move clues onto Lead assets: the more clues, the better the evidence for the police.

trueCulprit.title: The True Culprit
trueCulprit.body: After the interlude, one of ten versions of The True Culprit becomes both the current act and the current agenda, depending on your two Leads. Reaching its doom threshold leads to Resolution 2; completing its objective, to Resolution 1.
